description: **Feature.** New `prepush` check tag with 4 checks: `prepush-changelog-coverage`, `prepush-gitignore-guard`, `prepush-manual-warning`, and `test-suite`. Pre-push hook now runs `rlsbl check --tag prepush` instead of the deprecated `rlsbl pre-push-check`. Version-tag skip removed -- all checks always run. Fast-fail ordering via `depends_on`: test-suite skips if changelog coverage fails.
